jobs.title: Coding Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Coding Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Finland.

As a Coding Specialist and AI Trainer, you’ll use your software engineering expertise and Dutch fluency to help improve the capabilities of advanced AI systems.

You’ll evaluate how models reason through complex programming challenges across algorithms, architecture, development, infrastructure, and systems programming.

The role combines hands-on technical assessment with linguistic evaluation, requiring you to communicate naturally and precisely in Dutch.

You’ll challenge models with realistic software engineering scenarios, identify weaknesses, and document reproducible failures to improve future model performance.

Your feedback will help strengthen AI reasoning, coding accuracy, technical communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

The position offers flexible remote contract work for technically skilled professionals who enjoy analyzing complex problems and clearly explaining their reasoning.

Your contributions will help shape AI systems designed to support software development, education, research, and other knowledge-intensive applications.

Accountabilities

Engage with advanced AI models on software engineering tasks, technical scenarios, and coding challenges in Dutch.
Evaluate model responses for logical accuracy, technical correctness, coding quality, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
Assess AI performance across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming.
Challenge models with technical topics including asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding, and distributed systems debugging.
Verify the naturalness, fluency, and correctness of Dutch language usage in technical interactions.
Identify and document model failure modes, errors, and reproducible technical issues with sufficient detail for further analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback and suggestions to improve model reasoning, coding performance, prompt design, and evaluation methodologies.
Explain technical reasoning clearly and demonstrate your analytical process when evaluating model-generated solutions.
Contribute domain expertise that helps improve AI systems intended to support software development, research, education, and other technical applications.

Requirements

Strong professional coding or software engineering expertise, with experience across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend or backend development, cloud infrastructure, or systems programming.
Fluent Dutch language skills, with the ability to communicate naturally and accurately about complex technical subjects.
Strong understanding of software engineering concepts and the ability to critically evaluate technical solutions and code.
Experience with topics such as asynchronous programming, REST APIs, memory management, object-oriented programming, secure coding, or distributed systems is highly relevant.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.
Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and document findings in a structured, reproducible manner.
Strong technical writing skills in Dutch are an advantage.
Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline is preferred.
Real-world software development experience or open-source contributions is a plus.
Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explain not only what solution is correct but why.
Ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment and consistently deliver high-quality evaluations.
Comfortable working as an independent contractor and providing your own secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location.
Flexible remote contract work.
Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of advanced AI systems.
Exposure to challenging software engineering problems across a broad range of technical domains.
Opportunity to apply both coding expertise and Dutch language skills in an AI training environment.
Flexible freelance engagement without a fixed employee schedule.
Contractor arrangement with the ability to work remotely from an eligible location.
Contractors are responsible for providing their own secure computer and high-speed internet.
Company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and paid time off are not provided.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Software manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Manager
to lead software engineering activities for a large-scale Singapore public sector ICT project. You will manage the development team and oversee architecture, delivery, quality, security, and integration while ensuring compliance with government and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage the software engineering team across the full SDLC
, from design through deployment and maintenance.
Define and enforce software engineering, coding, testing, configuration management, and documentation standards.
Provide technical leadership across C#, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure
, and enterprise application environments.
Oversee application and system integration using REST APIs, IBM MQ, and IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE)
.
Coordinate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, QA, architects, and project teams to ensure successful delivery.
Lead technical and architecture reviews with customers, vendors, and government stakeholders.
Drive software quality through unit testing, code reviews, security scanning, defect management, and root-cause analysis.
Ensure secure development and compliance with IM8, ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and ISO/IEC 12207
.
Manage development progress, risks, dependencies, and engineering deliverables against project milestones.

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
8–12+ years
of software development experience with proven technical/team leadership responsibilities.
Strong understanding of C# and Microsoft SQL Server
development environments.
Experience managing enterprise software development teams and complex system integrations.
Good understanding of SDLC, DevSecOps, software quality, and secure development practices.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Experience with Singapore public sector / GovTech projects
and IM8 is highly preferred.
Knowledge of relevant standards such as ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001
is advantageous.
Nice to have:
Azure Cloud, Power BI, IBM MQ/ACE, REST APIs

jobs.title: Intern - Program Management System Developer
jobs.description:
The Program Management System Developer - Internship
will support the development, enhancement, and implementation of software applications, portals, dashboards, and monitoring tools to support the Program Management and Planning team.

The intern will work closely with the team to understand business and operational requirements and develop software solutions that improve data visibility, automate manual processes, and enhance planning efficiency. This role provides hands-on exposure to software development while allowing the intern to apply programming skills to real-world manufacturing and business operations.

Internship Period: Jan 2027 - Jun 2027

Responsibilities:

Support the development and enhancement of software applications, portals and monitoring systems for operational use.
Work with Program Management and Planning teams to understand business requirements and translate them into simple and effective system solutions.
Develop dashboards and tools to provide visibility of production, demand, purchase orders and operational performance.
Support the integration and optimization of reports, data and customer portals to reduce manual work and improve efficiency.
Develop tools to monitor changes in customer demand, purchase orders, cancellations and required delivery dates.
Assist in developing automated reports and systems to improve data accuracy, visibility and decision-making.
Analyze existing processes and identify opportunities for automation, system enhancement and continuous improvement.
Modify and enhance existing applications or programs based on business and operational requirements.
Write, test and implement efficient and reliable code.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues with existing systems and applications.
Collaborate with Program Management, Planning, Manufacturing, IT and other cross-functional teams to support project requirements and deliverables.
Document system requirements, processes and solutions.
Support other system development and continuous improvement projects as required.

Requirements

Currently pursuing a Degree in Computer Science, Electrical & Electronic Engineering
or a related discipline.
Programming experience in Java, C#/.NET, C/C++ or other relevant programming languages
.
Basic understanding of software development, databases and system development.

Experience with data analysis, dashboards or automation is preferred.

Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Able to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
Proactive, responsible and comfortable working with cross-functional teams.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Curious, hands-on and eager to learn about software development, automation and manufacturing operations.

Why Join Ichor?

Be Part of the Semiconductor Industry
: Gain exposure to advanced semiconductor manufacturing and see how technology and software support real-world manufacturing operations.
Hands-On Learning
: Work on real projects involving software development, automation, dashboards and operational systems, while learning from experienced professionals.
Build Your Career:
Develop practical skills in programming, system development, data analysis, process automation and project collaboration.
People & Culture
: Join an inclusive workplace that values innovation, collaboration, operational excellence, honesty, reliability and employee wellbeing.

· Hands-on experience with Mule 4

REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, XML, JSON, and RAML.

API Manager, Exchange, Runtime Manager, and Design Center

· Strong knowledge of Git, Jenkins/Azure DevOps, Maven, and CI/CD processes.
· Experience working with Salesforce integrations is highly preferred.

Desired skills*

· Experience with Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, or other enterprise applications.
· Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
